Trigger.Name: WHEN-CREATE-RECORD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 CH VARCHAR2(100);
 RET NUMBER;
begin
 IF :PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE IS NOT NULL THEN
 :FROM_BROKER :=:PARAMETER.P_BRKR_NBR;
 END IF; 
 
 IF :FROM_BROKER IS NOT NULL AND :PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE IS NOT NULL THEN
 SELECT BKM.BRKR_NAME BRKR_NAME INTO :P_BROKER_NAME
 FROM BRKR_MSTR BKM
 WHERE BKM.PORT_CD = DECODE(:PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE,2,99,5,99,:FROM_PORT) AND
 BKM.LIC_TYPE = :PARAMETER.P_LIC_TYPE AND
 BKM.LIC_NBR = :FROM_BROKER;
 
 IF GET_ITEM_PROPERTY('FROM_BROKER',ENABLED)='TRUE' THEN
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('FROM_BROKER',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('P_BROKER',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('P_BROKER_NAME',ENABLED,PROPERTY_FALSE);
 END IF;
 ELSE 
 :FROM_BROKER :=NULL;
 :P_BROKER_NAME :=NULL;
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('FROM_BROKER',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('P_BROKER',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 SET_ITEM_PROPERTY('P_BROKER_NAME',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 END IF;
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(25,20,'ERROR');
 :FROM_BROKER :=NULL;
 :P_BROKER_NAME :=NULL;
 END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_VALUE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE check_value
IS
 kword VARCHAR2 (300);
 statment VARCHAR2 (1000);
 ch VARCHAR2 (1);
 v_desc VARCHAR2 (1000);
 pl_id paramlist;
 v_report_file VARCHAR2 (100);
 v_count NUMBER (5);
 v_check_date DATE;
 v_temp NUMBER (5);
 msg NUMBER;
BEGIN
 v_count := 0;

-- V_CHECK_DATE := HIJDATE.Add_Hij_Days(HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE,-:P_DAYS);
--=======================================================================
 /*
 BEGIN
 SELECT 1
 INTO v_count
 FROM DUAL
 WHERE EXISTS (
 SELECT 1
 FROM declarations, credit_letters cltr
 WHERE declarations.port_cd = cltr.port_cd(+)
 AND declarations.cl_nbr = cltr.cr_letr_nbr(+)
 AND declarations.cl_dt = cltr.cr_letr_dt(+)
 AND declarations.cl_type = cltr.cr_letr_type(+)
 AND exit_dcltn_type IS NULL
 AND exit_doc_nbr IS NULL
 AND exit_doc_date IS NULL
 AND declarations.final_ctry_cd <> 100
 AND ( ( :from_broker IS NOT NULL
 AND declarations.brkr_port_cd = 99
 AND declarations.lic_type IN (2,5)
 AND declarations.lic_nbr = :from_broker
 )
 OR (:from_broker IS NULL)
 )
--AND DCLTN_DT <= :P_LIMIT_DT
 AND ( (declarations.dcltn_dt >= :start_dt)
 OR (:start_dt IS NULL)
 )
 AND ( (declarations.dcltn_dt <= :end_dt)
 OR (:end_dt IS NULL)
 )
 AND declarations.dcltn_type_cd IN (1, 2)
 AND EXISTS (
 SELECT NULL
 FROM coll_orders c
 WHERE c.port_cd = declarations.port_cd
 AND c.coll_ordr_nbr = declarations.dcltn_nbr
 AND c.coll_ordr_dt = declarations.dcltn_dt
 AND c.coll_ordr_ctgry = declarations.dcltn_type_cd
 AND c.coll_dt IS NOT NULL));
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS
 THEN
 v_count := 0;
 END;
*/
--=====================================================================================
 v_count := 1;
 IF NVL (v_count, 0) > 0
 THEN
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 pl_id := GET_PARAMETER_LIST ('tmpdata');

 IF NOT ID_NULL (pl_id)
 THEN
 DESTROY_PARAMETER_LIST (pl_id);
 END IF;

 --:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE := 'DCLN5040.REP';
 pl_id := CREATE_PARAMETER_LIST ('tmpdata');
 ADD_PARAMETER (pl_id, 'DESTYPE', text_parameter, 'SCREEN');
 ADD_PARAMETER (pl_id, 'PARAMFORM', text_parameter, 'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER (pl_id, 'PRINTJOB', text_parameter, 'NO');
 ADD_PARAMETER (pl_id,
 'P_CURR_PORT_CD',
 text_parameter,
 :parameter.p_curr_port_cd
 );
 ADD_PARAMETER (pl_id,
 'P_MODULE_NAME',
 text_parameter,
 :parameter.p_module_name
 );
 ADD_PARAMETER (pl_id, 'P_REPORT_NO', text_parameter, :report_no);
 ADD_PARAMETER (pl_id,
 'START_DT',
 text_parameter,
 TO_CHAR (:start_dt, 'MI-MM-RRRR')
 );
 ADD_PARAMETER (pl_id,
 'END_DT',
 text_parameter,
 TO_CHAR (:end_dt, 'MI-MM-RRRR')
 );
 ADD_PARAMETER (pl_id,
 'P_DEC_INS_REP_USR',
 text_parameter,
 :parameter.p_dec_ins_rep_usr
 );
 ADD_PARAMETER (pl_id, 'P_LIC_NBR', text_parameter, :from_broker);

 --Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_LIMIT_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:LIMIT_DT,'MI-MM-RRRR'));
 IF :from_broker IS NOT NULL
 THEN

 --Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_DAYS',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_DAYS);

 ADD_PARAMETER (pl_id, 'MAXIMIZE', text_parameter, 'YES');

 pl_id,
 NULL
 );
 ELSE

 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: PRINT_CHECK_VALUE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE PRINT_CHECK_VALUE IS
 kword VARCHAR2(300);
 statment VARCHAR2(1000);
 ch VARCHAR2(1);
 V_DESC VARCHAR2 (1000);
 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100); 
 V_COUNT NUMBER(5);
 V_CHECK_DATE DATE;
 V_TEMP NUMBER(5);
 MSG NUMBER;

 BEGIN 
V_COUNT := 0;
-- V_CHECK_DATE := HIJDATE.Add_Hij_Days(HIJDATE.CUR_HIJ_DATE,-:P_DAYS); 
--=======================================================================
BEGIN
SELECT 1 INTO V_COUNT FROM DUAL WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM 
DECLARATIONS,CREDIT_LETTERS CLTR

WHERE 


 CLTR.PORT_CD = DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD AND
 CLTR.CR_LETR_NBR = DECLARATIONS.CL_NBR AND
 CLTR.CR_LETR_DT = DECLARATIONS.CL_DT AND
 CLTR.CR_LETR_TYPE = DECLARATIONS.CL_TYPE

AND EXIT_DCLTN_TYPE IS NULL 
AND EXIT_DOC_NBR IS NULL
AND EXIT_DOC_DATE IS NULL

AND DECLARATIONS.FINAL_CTRY_CD <> 100
AND
(
(:FROM_BROKER IS NOT NULL
AND 99 = DECLARATIONS.BRKR_PORT_CD
AND DECLARATIONS.LIC_TYPE IN (2,5)
AND :FROM_BROKER = DECLARATIONS.LIC_NBR
)
OR 
(:FROM_BROKER IS NULL)
)
--AND DCLTN_DT <= :P_LIMIT_DT
AND ((DCLTN_DT >= :START_DT) OR (:START_DT IS NULL)) 
AND ((DCLTN_DT <= :END_DT) OR (:END_DT IS NULL)) 
AND DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2)
AND exists (select null from coll_orders c where c.port_cd = DECLARATIONS.port_cd and c.coll_ordr_nbr = DECLARATIONS.dcltn_nbr and c.coll_ordr_dt = DECLARATIONS.dcltn_dt and c.coll_ordr_ctgry = DECLARATIONS.dcltn_type_cd and c.coll_dt is not null)

);
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 V_COUNT := 0;
END;
 --=====================================================================================
 IF NVL(v_count,0) > 0 then 
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 
 --:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE := 'DCLN5040.REP';
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_CURR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,:parameter.P_CURR_PORT_CD);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_MODULE_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REPORT_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:REPORT_NO);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'START_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:START_DT,'MI-MM-RRRR'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'END_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:END_DT,'MI-MM-RRRR'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_DEC_INS_REP_USR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:PARAMETER.P_DEC_INS_REP_USR);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_LIC_NBR',TEXT_PARAMETER,:FROM_BROKER);
 --Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_LIMIT_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:LIMIT_DT,'MI-MM-RRRR'));
 IF :FROM_BROKER IS NOT NULL THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_BRKR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,99);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_LIC_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,2);
 ELSE
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_BRKR_PORT_CD',TEXT_PARAMETER,NULL);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_LIC_TYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,NULL);
 
 END IF;
 
 --Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_DAYS',TEXT_PARAMETER,:P_DAYS);
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS , V_REPORT_FILE , SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 
 ELSE
 
msg := STR.DispArbMsg(7,180 ,'ERROR'); 
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
END;

 DECLARE
 v_rg_id RECORDGROUP;
 F VARCHAR2(7);
 T VARCHAR2(11);
 V_DEC_INS_REP_USR VARCHAR2(100);
 
 
 tmp_str VARCHAR2(2000);
rg_id RecordGroup;
gc_id GroupColumn; 
gc_id2 GroupColumn;
the_Rowcount NUMBER;
sel_row NUMBER;
the_val VARCHAR2(20);
the_val2 VARCHAR2(20);

 BEGIN
 V_DEC_INS_REP_USR :=NVL(GNRL.GET_CUSTOMS_SETTING('DEC_INS_REP_USR',21),'0');
 
 --------
 
 v_rg_id :=FIND_GROUP('DCLN_STA');
 if id_null(v_rg_id) then
 
 v_rg_id := create_GROUP_FROM_QUERY('DCLN_STA',
 'SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(DCLTN_TYPE_CD) DCLTN_TYP_CD,TO_CHAR(DCLTN_STA_CD) DCLTN_STA_CD
 FROM DCLTN_STATUS
 WHERE (
 DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (1,2) AND 
 ( 
 (DCLTN_STA_CD <> 6 AND :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID NOT IN ('|| V_DEC_INS_REP_USR ||') )
 OR
 :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID IN ('|| V_DEC_INS_REP_USR ||')
 )
 ) 
 OR 
 (
 DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3,4,5,6) AND 
 ( 
 (DCLTN_STA_CD <> 8 AND :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID NOT IN ('|| V_DEC_INS_REP_USR ||') )
 OR
 :PARAMETER.P_JOB_ID IN ('|| V_DEC_INS_REP_USR ||')
 )
 
 ) 
 ORDER BY 2');
 
 END if;
 if populate_group(v_rg_id) = 0 then
 populate_list('P_DCLTN_STA',v_rg_id);
 
--BEGIN
:PARAMETER.P_DEC_INS_REP_USR := 1 ;
 gc_id:=Find_Column('DCLN_STA'||'.'||'DCLTN_STA_CD'); 
 gc_id2:=Find_Column('DCLN_STA'||'.'||'DCLTN_TYP_CD');
 the_Rowcount := GET_GROUP_ROW_COUNT(v_rg_id);
 FOR j IN 1..the_Rowcount LOOP
 the_val := Get_Group_CHAR_Cell(gc_id, J);
 the_val2 := Get_Group_CHAR_Cell(gc_id2, J);
 IF (the_val = '6' AND the_val2 IN('1','2'))OR (the_val = '8' AND the_val2 IN('3','4','5','6')) THEN 
 :PARAMETER.P_DEC_INS_REP_USR := 0 ;
 EXIT;
 
 END IF;
 
 END LOOP;
-- END; 

 END if;
 
 END;
